sentences.text: Black Sabbath were an English rock band , formed in Birmingham in 1968 , by guitarist and main songwriter Tony Iommi , bassist and main lyricist Geezer Butler , singer Ozzy Osbourne , and drummer Bill Ward .	Geezer Butler	Geezer Butler	Tony Iommi	Tony Iommi	Bill Ward	Bill Ward (musician)	Ozzy Osbourne	Ozzy Osbourne	rock	rock music	Birmingham	Birmingham	Black Sabbath	Black Sabbath (album)
The band experienced multiple line-up changes , with Iommi being the only constant member throughout its history .

Originally formed as a blues rock band , the group soon adopted the Black Sabbath moniker and began incorporating occult themes with horror-inspired lyrics and tuned-down guitars .	rock	rock music	Black Sabbath	Black Sabbath (album)
They also composed songs about social instability , political corruption and drugs .
Osbourne 's regular use of alcohol and other drugs led to his dismissal from the band in 1979 .
He was replaced by former Rainbow vocalist Ronnie James Dio .	Dio	Dio (band)	Rainbow	Rainbow (rock band)	Ronnie James Dio	Ronnie James Dio

Following two albums with Dio , Black Sabbath endured many personnel changes in the 1980s and 1990s that included vocalists Ian Gillan , Glenn Hughes , Ray Gillen and Tony Martin , as well as several drummers and bassists .	Dio	Dio (band)	Ian Gillan	Ian Gillan	Glenn Hughes	Glenn Hughes	Ray Gillen	Ray Gillen	Tony Martin	Tony Martin (British singer)	Black Sabbath	Black Sabbath (album)
In 1992 , Iommi and Butler rejoined Dio and drummer Vinny Appice to record Dehumanizer .	Dio	Dio (band)	Vinny Appice	Vinny Appice	Dehumanizer	Dehumanizer
The original line-up reunited with Osbourne in 1997 and released a live album Reunion .	Reunion	Reunion (Black Sabbath album)

Black Sabbath 's final studio album and nineteenth overall , 13 -LRB- 2013 -RRB- , features all of the original members but Ward , who left the band prior to the recording sessions due to a contract dispute .	13	13 (Black Sabbath album)	Black Sabbath	Black Sabbath (album)

A year after embarking on a farewell tour , the band played their final concert in their home city of Birmingham on 4 February 2017 , after which they broke up .	Birmingham	Birmingham	farewell tour	The End Tour
Iommi has stated , however , that he has not ruled out the possibility of new material or one-off shows under the Black Sabbath name .	Black Sabbath	Black Sabbath (album)
Black Sabbath are often cited as pioneers of heavy metal music .	heavy metal music	heavy metal music	Black Sabbath	Black Sabbath (album)

The band helped define the genre with releases such as Black Sabbath -LRB- 1970 -RRB- , Paranoid -LRB- 1970 -RRB- and Master of Reality -LRB- 1971 -RRB- .	Black Sabbath	Black Sabbath (album)	Paranoid	Paranoid (album)	Master of Reality	Master of Reality
They were ranked by MTV as the `` Greatest Metal Band '' of all time , and placed second in VH1 's `` 100 Greatest Artists of Hard Rock '' list .	MTV	MTV	VH1	VH1
Rolling Stone magazine ranked them number 85 in their `` 100 Greatest Artists of All Time '' .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone
They have sold over 70 million records worldwide .

Black Sabbath were inducted into the UK Music Hall of Fame in 2005 and the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2006 .	Black Sabbath	Black Sabbath (album)	UK Music Hall of Fame	UK Music Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
